[Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/kenya_medium_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2021, classifying geographic areas by food insecurity phase based on field assessments and secondary data. The resulting spatial datasets represent projected acute food insecurity conditions across Kenya for each month, enabling temporal tracking of food security crises.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys to classify acute food insecurity severity by geographic area and scenario.
